verdict.rationale: Published board power, connector requirements and cooling guidance are a fair question for any GPU, so the axis applies. The pack gives no TDP/TGP figure, connector specification or cooling guidance for the H200 SXM. It only says the H200 has 'the same power profile as the H100' without a number, and it describes the separate H200 NVL variant as air-cooled, which does not transfer to the SXM card.

support.subject: As a gamer, I can spec a build around published board power — TDP/TGP, connector requirements, and cooling guidance for this exact card
